# What the gate's interpreter needs on a hosted runner (.github/workflows/test.yml).
#
# Pinned to the versions in the Mac's `.caches/spike-venv`, the interpreter
# every recorded baseline was measured under (AGENTS.md §13, §15.2), read off
# its site-packages on 2026-10-03 -- not "latest", so a CI result and a local
# one disagree only because of the runner, never because of a resolver.
#
# torch is NOT here: it is installed separately, first, because on Linux it
# must come from the CPU index (the PyPI Linux wheel pulls ~3 GB of CUDA
# libraries onto a runner with no GPU) and on macOS from PyPI. Both are 2.13.0,
# the version `vendor_torch.sh` vendors (publish-pypi.yml TORCH_WHEEL_VERSION).
#
# Deliberately absent:
#   coremltools  -- on a hosted runner the CoreML tests would stop skipping by
#                   name and start asking for a Neural Engine that is not
#                   there; .github/scripts/gate_suites.py keeps the suites that need
#                   it local-only. The macOS job's probe installs it in a
#                   separate venv to measure CoreML, outside the gate.
#   executorch   -- test_qnn.py reaches it through TORCHNATIVE_QNN_PYTHON, a
#                   separate interpreter, by design; unset here, it skips by name.
#   ml_dtypes    -- AGENTS.md §15.2.
numpy==2.5.2
safetensors==0.8.0
transformers==5.15.1
tokenizers==0.22.2
huggingface_hub==1.28.0
sentencepiece==0.2.2
typing_extensions==4.16.0
packaging==26.3
pyyaml==6.0.3
regex==2026.7.19
psutil  # transformers continuous batching reads cpu memory through it (tests/models/test_cbpath, test_cbwalls)
